plainTranslation: A's identity meets B's drive. The sextile supports them, if you act on it.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Synced from authored synastry bundle synastry-authored__19_ (2).json.
summaryDeep: Their initiative and your identity move well together. You spur each other to act. Take on something that needs both your engines.
tension: Because this energy is easygoing, it can be easy to overlook. You may not always notice how much you motivate each other until you compare it to relationships where nothing ever seems to move forward.
advice: The key is not to overthink it. Make the plan, send the text, take the first step. This connection tends to work best when the two of you are actually doing things together instead of just talking about them.
summaryShort: Their initiative and your identity move well together.
